verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents per-user flag overrides for individual users ("identities") and names internal testing and QA as use cases. Its segments are described as a way to release features to beta testers, and the GitHub README says flags can be toggled for specific users. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of excluding individual users (only implied by overrides), list-based bulk allowlist targeting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
